detail: Tests the specified coefficient restriction on the existing fit. car selects its reference statistic from the model class; a GLM chi-square test differs from the OLS F test used by Stata regress postestimation.
detail_zh: 对已有模型检验所示系数约束。car根据模型类选择参考统计量；GLM的卡方检验不同于Stata regress后估计的OLS F检验。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::lm(y ~ x+z,data=data)
meaning: test a single regression coefficient

task: Jointly test two regression coefficients
task_zh: 联合检验两个回归系数
detail: Tests the specified coefficient restriction on the existing fit. car selects its reference statistic from the model class; a GLM chi-square test differs from the OLS F test used by Stata regress postestimation.
detail_zh: 对已有模型检验所示系数约束。car根据模型类选择参考统计量；GLM的卡方检验不同于Stata regress后估计的OLS F检验。

task: Test equality of two regression slopes
task_zh: 检验两个回归斜率相等
detail: Tests the specified coefficient restriction on the existing fit. car selects its reference statistic from the model class; a GLM chi-square test differs from the OLS F test used by Stata regress postestimation.

task: Jointly test a categorical predictor
task_zh: 联合检验分类解释变量
detail: The restrictions name the fitted factor coefficients explicitly. Different reference levels or contrasts require different coefficient names; this is not an automatic expansion of any Stata factor-variable expression.
detail_zh: 约束显式指定已拟合的因子系数。参考水平或对比编码不同时须修改系数名；不自动展开任意Stata因子变量表达式。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::lm(y~x+g,data=data)

task: Estimate the sum of two slopes with its standard error
task_zh: 估计两个斜率之和及标准误
detail: The contrast vector assumes coefficient order intercept, x, z. Returns the estimate and its covariance-based standard error only; Stata also prints tests and confidence limits.
detail_zh: 对比向量假定系数顺序为截距、x、z。仅返回估计及按协方差计算的标准误；Stata还打印检验和置信限。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::lm(y ~ x+z,data=data)
meaning: estimate the sum of two slopes with its standard error

task: Estimate a difference of slopes with its standard error
task_zh: 估计两个斜率之差及标准误
detail: The contrast vector assumes coefficient order intercept, x, z. Returns the estimate and its covariance-based standard error only; Stata also prints tests and confidence limits.
detail_zh: 对比向量假定系数顺序为截距、x、z。仅返回估计及按协方差计算的标准误；Stata还打印检验和置信限。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::lm(y ~ x+z,data=data)
meaning: estimate a difference of slopes with its standard error

task: Use the delta method for a ratio of slopes
task_zh: 使用Delta方法估计斜率比
detail: Uses the first-order delta method on named fitted coefficients. Returns the transformed estimate and standard error; Stata also prints reference tests and confidence limits.
detail_zh: 对具名已拟合系数采用一阶delta方法。返回变换估计和标准误；Stata还打印参考检验及置信限。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::lm(y ~ x+z,data=data)
meaning: use the delta method for a ratio of slopes

task: Use the delta method for an exponentiated slope
task_zh: 使用Delta方法估计指数化斜率
detail: Uses the first-order delta method on named fitted coefficients. Returns the transformed estimate and standard error; Stata also prints reference tests and confidence limits.
detail_zh: 对具名已拟合系数采用一阶delta方法。返回变换估计和标准误；Stata还打印参考检验及置信限。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::glm(b ~ x+z,data=data,family=stats::binomial())
meaning: use the delta method for an exponentiated slope

task: Test an exponentiated coefficient with a nonlinear Wald test
task_zh: 用非线性Wald检验检验指数化系数
detail: Forms a one-degree-of-freedom Wald chi-square from a first-order delta-method standard error. The R vector omits Stata coefficient and confidence-interval output.
detail_zh: 用一阶delta标准误构造单自由度Wald卡方。R向量不包含Stata的系数及置信区间输出。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::glm(b ~ x+z,data=data,family=stats::binomial())
meaning: test an exponentiated coefficient with a nonlinear wald test

task: Compare nested maximum-likelihood models
task_zh: 比较嵌套的最大似然模型
detail: Fixed workflow.
detail_zh: 固定流程。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::glm(b ~ x+z,data=data,family=stats::binomial()); full <- fit; reduced <- stats::update(fit,.~.-z)
meaning: compare nested maximum-likelihood models

r: { X <- stats::model.matrix(fit); beta <- stats::coef(fit); p <- stats::fitted(fit); gradient <- beta["x"]*colMeans(X*as.vector(p*(1-p)*(1-2*p))); gradient["x"] <- gradient["x"]+mean(p*(1-p)); c(estimate=unname(beta["x"]*mean(p*(1-p))),se=sqrt(drop(t(gradient)%*%stats::vcov(fit)%*%gradient))) }
task: Average a continuous-predictor marginal effect
task_zh: 计算连续解释变量的平均边际效应
detail: Uses the fitted GLM and its estimation data; reference grids and averaging rules should be chosen explicitly.
detail_zh: 使用已拟合GLM及其估计数据；需明确选择参照网格与平均规则。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::glm(b ~ x+z,data=data,family=stats::binomial())
meaning: average a continuous-predictor marginal effect

r: { X <- colMeans(stats::model.matrix(fit)); beta <- stats::coef(fit); p <- stats::plogis(sum(X*beta)); c(estimate=unname(beta["x"]*p*(1-p))) }
task: Evaluate a marginal effect at mean covariates
task_zh: 在协变量均值处计算边际效应
detail: Returns the derivative at means; use a delta-method gradient if standard errors are needed.
detail_zh: 返回协变量均值处的导数；标准误需另外计算Delta方法梯度。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::glm(b ~ x+z,data=data,family=stats::binomial())
meaning: evaluate a marginal effect at mean covariates

task: Predict at specified covariate values
task_zh: 在指定协变量值处计算预测
detail: At each x value, predictions are averaged over the observed distribution of z.
detail_zh: 在每个x取值处，按z的实际观测分布对预测值取平均。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::glm(b ~ x+z,data=data,family=stats::binomial())
meaning: predict at specified covariate values

task: Average predictions on the linear-index scale
task_zh: 计算线性指数尺度的平均预测
detail: Uses the fitted GLM and its estimation data; reference grids and averaging rules should be chosen explicitly.
detail_zh: 使用已拟合GLM及其估计数据；需明确选择参照网格与平均规则。
setup: data <- transform(mtcars, y=mpg, x=wt, z=hp, g=factor(cyl), b=rep(c(0L,1L),16), count=carb); fit <- stats::glm(b ~ x+z,data=data,family=stats::binomial())
meaning: average predictions on the linear-index scale

task: Test a mean against a specified value
task_zh: 对指定值检验总体均值

detail_zh: 显式选择合并方差、Welch或配对推断。R返回htest对象；因子水平顺序不同时差值方向可能相反，须统一组序和非缺失样本。
meaning: test a mean against a specified value

task_zh: 使用Welch异方差方法比较均值

detail_zh: 显式选择合并方差、Welch或配对推断。R返回htest对象；因子水平顺序不同时差值方向可能相反，须统一组序和非缺失样本。
meaning: compare two means using welch unequal-variance inference

task: Test paired mean differences
task_zh: 检验配对均值之差
detail: Selects pooled, Welch or paired inference explicitly. R returns an htest object and may reverse the reported difference when factor-level order differs; match group order and the nonmissing sample.
detail_zh: 显式选择合并方差、Welch或配对推断。R返回htest对象；因子水平顺序不同时差值方向可能相反，须统一组序和非缺失样本。
meaning: test paired mean differences

task: Compute a 90 percent interval for a mean
task_zh: 计算均值的90%置信区间
detail: Selects pooled, Welch or paired inference explicitly. R returns an htest object and may reverse the reported difference when factor-level order differs; match group order and the nonmissing sample.
detail_zh: 显式选择合并方差、Welch或配对推断。R返回htest对象；因子水平顺序不同时差值方向可能相反，须统一组序和非缺失样本。

task: Compare variances of two independent normal samples
task_zh: 比较两个独立正态样本的方差
detail: Uses a normal-theory variance-ratio or chi-square test. R returns test components in an htest object or vector; Stata also reports one-sided alternatives and additional confidence limits.
detail_zh: 采用正态理论的方差比或卡方检验。R以htest对象或向量返回检验分量；Stata还报告单侧备择及额外置信限。
meaning: compare variances of two independent normal samples

task: Compare two unpaired sample variances
task_zh: 比较两个非配对样本方差
detail: Uses a normal-theory variance-ratio or chi-square test. R returns test components in an htest object or vector; Stata also reports one-sided alternatives and additional confidence limits.
detail_zh: 采用正态理论的方差比或卡方检验。R以htest对象或向量返回检验分量；Stata还报告单侧备择及额外置信限。
meaning: compare two unpaired sample variances

task: Compare independent distributions with the rank-sum test
task_zh: 使用秩和检验比较独立分布
detail: Aligns the requested exact or uncorrected asymptotic Wilcoxon calculation. Tie handling, group ordering and reported rank-sum versus U-statistic conventions must be aligned.
detail_zh: 按要求选择精确或未作连续性修正的渐近Wilcoxon计算。须统一并列处理、组序及报告秩和还是U统计量的约定。
meaning: compare independent distributions with the rank-sum test

task: Use exact rank-sum inference without ties
task_zh: 在无并列值时使用精确秩和推断
detail: Aligns the requested exact or uncorrected asymptotic Wilcoxon calculation. Tie handling, group ordering and reported rank-sum versus U-statistic conventions must be aligned.
detail_zh: 按要求选择精确或未作连续性修正的渐近Wilcoxon计算。须统一并列处理、组序及报告秩和还是U统计量的约定。
meaning: use exact rank-sum inference without ties

task: Use a paired signed-rank test with ties
task_zh: 对含并列值的配对差使用符号秩检验
detail: Uses the paired Wilcoxon asymptotic calculation without continuity correction. R omits zero differences; ties and small-sample variance conventions can affect the reference approximation.
detail_zh: 采用无连续性修正的配对Wilcoxon渐近计算。R忽略零差值；并列值及小样本方差约定会影响参考近似。
meaning: use a paired signed-rank test with ties

task: Test the median paired difference using signs
task_zh: 使用符号检验检验配对差的中位数
detail: Drops zero paired differences and applies an exact two-sided binomial test. The displayed R interval concerns the probability of a positive difference, not a confidence interval for the paired median.
detail_zh: 剔除配对零差值并采用精确双侧二项检验。R显示的区间针对正差概率，而非配对中位数的置信区间。
meaning: test the median paired difference using signs

task: Test equality of distributions across groups
task_zh: 检验多个组的分布相等
detail: Computes the tie-corrected Kruskal-Wallis chi-square approximation. R returns an htest object without Stata group rank-sum summaries.
detail_zh: 计算经并列修正的Kruskal-Wallis卡方近似。R返回htest对象，不含Stata的各组秩和汇总。
meaning: test equality of distributions across groups

task: Compare two empirical distribution functions
task_zh: 比较两个经验分布函数
detail: The two-sample form uses a grouping variable; a one-sample test instead requires a fully specified reference CDF.
detail_zh: 双样本形式使用分组变量；单样本检验则需要完整指定参照累积分布函数。
meaning: compare two empirical distribution functions

task: Test univariate normality with Shapiro-Wilk
task_zh: 使用Shapiro-Wilk检验单变量正态性
detail: Computes the Shapiro-Wilk W test; R permits 3 to 5000 nonmissing observations. Stata also displays transformed statistics and uses its own approximation and sample-size rules.
detail_zh: 计算Shapiro-Wilk W检验；R允许3至5000个非缺失观测。Stata还显示变换统计量，并采用自身的近似及样本量规则。
meaning: test univariate normality with shapiro-wilk

task: Test a binary success probability exactly
task_zh: 精确检验二元变量成功概率
detail: Returns an exact two-sided binomial test. The code assumes the displayed binary sample has no missing values; Stata additionally prints lower- and upper-tail probabilities.
detail_zh: 返回精确双侧二项检验。代码假定所示二元样本无缺失；Stata还打印下尾和上尾概率。
meaning: test a binary success probability exactly

task: Run an exact binomial test from counts
task_zh: 根据计数运行精确二项检验
detail: Uses an exact two-sided binomial test from the supplied count and total. R reports one htest result; Stata additionally displays both one-sided probabilities.
detail_zh: 按给定次数和总数采用精确双侧二项检验。R报告一个htest结果；Stata还显示两个单侧概率。
meaning: run an exact binomial test from counts

task: Run an uncorrected large-sample one-proportion test
task_zh: 运行无连续性校正的大样本单比例检验
detail: Disables the R continuity correction for the normal-approximation proportion test. R reports a chi-square statistic whose square root is the absolute Stata z; signed direction requires the group order.
detail_zh: 关闭R比例正态近似检验的连续性修正。R报告卡方，其平方根是Stata z的绝对值；正负方向取决于组序。
meaning: run an uncorrected large-sample one-proportion test

task: Compare two proportions without continuity correction
task_zh: 比较两个比例且不使用连续性校正
detail: Disables the R continuity correction for the normal-approximation proportion test. R reports a chi-square statistic whose square root is the absolute Stata z; signed direction requires the group order.
detail_zh: 关闭R比例正态近似检验的连续性修正。R报告卡方，其平方根是Stata z的绝对值；正负方向取决于组序。
meaning: compare two proportions without continuity correction

task: Compare proportions from aggregate sample sizes
task_zh: 根据汇总样本量比较比例
detail: Disables continuity correction. R returns a chi-square test; Stata reports a signed z and one-sided probabilities, although the two-sided p-values correspond for the same counts.
detail_zh: 不作连续性修正。R返回卡方检验，Stata报告带符号z和单侧概率；给定相同计数时双侧p值对应。
meaning: compare proportions from aggregate sample sizes

task: Compute a Student-t confidence interval for a mean
task_zh: 计算均值的Student-t置信区间
detail: Returns only the selected confidence limits, not Stata sample-size and point-estimate columns. Match nonmissing sample size, confidence level and the explicit interval method.
detail_zh: 仅返回所选置信限，不含Stata的样本量和点估计列。须统一非缺失样本量、置信水平及显式区间方法。
meaning: compute a student-t confidence interval for a mean

task_zh: 计算Clopper-Pearson比例置信区间

detail_zh: 仅返回所选置信限，不含Stata的样本量和点估计列。须统一非缺失样本量、置信水平及显式区间方法。
meaning: compute a clopper-pearson proportion interval

detail_zh: 仅返回所选置信限，不含Stata的样本量和点估计列。须统一非缺失样本量、置信水平及显式区间方法。
meaning: compute a wilson score interval for a proportion

task: Compute an exact proportion interval from counts
task_zh: 根据计数计算精确比例置信区间
detail: Computes confidence limits from the displayed summary inputs. The R result omits Stata sample-size and point-estimate columns; the stated method and confidence level determine the interval.
detail_zh: 按所示汇总输入计算置信限。R结果省略Stata的样本量和点估计列；区间取决于指定方法和置信水平。
meaning: compute an exact proportion interval from counts

task: Compute a mean interval from summary statistics
task_zh: 根据汇总统计量计算均值区间
detail: Computes confidence limits from the displayed summary inputs. The R result omits Stata sample-size and point-estimate columns; the stated method and confidence level determine the interval.
detail_zh: 按所示汇总输入计算置信限。R结果省略Stata的样本量和点估计列；区间取决于指定方法和置信水平。
meaning: compute a mean interval from summary statistics

task: Compute a normal-theory variance interval
task_zh: 计算正态理论方差置信区间
detail: Returns only the selected confidence limits, not Stata sample-size and point-estimate columns. Match nonmissing sample size, confidence level and the explicit interval method.
detail_zh: 仅返回所选置信限，不含Stata的样本量和点估计列。须统一非缺失样本量、置信水平及显式区间方法。
meaning: compute a normal-theory variance interval

task: Compute a normal-theory standard-deviation interval
task_zh: 计算正态理论标准差置信区间
detail: Returns only the selected confidence limits, not Stata sample-size and point-estimate columns. Match nonmissing sample size, confidence level and the explicit interval method.
detail_zh: 仅返回所选置信限，不含Stata的样本量和点估计列。须统一非缺失样本量、置信水平及显式区间方法。
meaning: compute a normal-theory standard-deviation interval

task: Test one normal population standard deviation
task_zh: 检验一个正态总体的标准差
detail: Uses a normal-theory variance-ratio or chi-square test. R returns test components in an htest object or vector; Stata also reports one-sided alternatives and additional confidence limits.
detail_zh: 采用正态理论的方差比或卡方检验。R以htest对象或向量返回检验分量；Stata还报告单侧备择及额外置信限。
meaning: test one normal population standard deviation

task: Run a two-group median test
task_zh: 运行两组中位数检验
detail: Tests independence of group and the above-pooled-median indicator. The example assigns observations tied at the median to the lower category; align Stata ties() handling before comparison.
detail_zh: 检验组别与高于合并中位数指标的独立性。本例将恰等于中位数的观测归入低类别；比较前须统一Stata的ties()处理。
meaning: run a two-group median test

detail_zh: 按所示代码使用常规等方差单因素模型或合并方差成对t检验。R对象布局不同，不复现Stata全部tabulate列或比较显示。
meaning: fit one-way analysis of variance

task_zh: 使用Bonferroni校正比较组均值

detail_zh: 按所示代码使用常规等方差单因素模型或合并方差成对t检验。R对象布局不同，不复现Stata全部tabulate列或比较显示。

detail_zh: table排除缺失观测，未使用因子水平可能影响维度。R的htest对象提供所选Pearson或Fisher检验，不含Stata的行列百分比显示。

task_zh: 运行双向表Fisher精确检验
detail: table excludes missing observations and unused factor levels can affect dimensions. The R htest object provides the selected Pearson or Fisher test without Stata row and column percentage displays.
detail_zh: table排除缺失观测，未使用因子水平可能影响维度。R的htest对象提供所选Pearson或Fisher检验，不含Stata的行列百分比显示。
meaning: run a fisher exact test for a two-way table

task: Run a Pearson test from immediate cell counts

task: Base R alternative for Spearman rank association
task_zh: Spearman 秩相关的 base R 替代方案
detail: This base R alternative uses cor.test(..., exact = FALSE), with average ranks for ties and a t approximation for p-values. Use tidystata::spearman(data, y, x) for Stata 18+'s four-moment beta p-values with a normal fallback, or add .pairwise = TRUE for Stata's pw option. With two selected variables, casewise and pairwise samples coincide; with more variables they can differ. Constant variables give undefined correlations in tidystata, whereas Stata reports rho = 1.
detail_zh: 此 base R 替代方案使用 cor.test(..., exact = FALSE)，并列值取平均秩，p 值采用 t 近似。需要 Stata 18 起的四阶矩 beta p 值及正态回退近似时，请用 tidystata::spearman(data, y, x)；加 .pairwise = TRUE 对应 Stata 的 pw 选项。只选两个变量时，完整个案与成对删除使用相同样本；变量更多时可能不同。常量变量在 tidystata 中的相关系数未定义，而 Stata 报告 rho = 1。

meaning: perform pca directly on a correlation matrix

stata: pca x y z w, components(2)
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Retain two principal components
task_zh: 保留两个主成分
detail: Selects correlation or covariance PCA explicitly. Component signs are arbitrary; prcomp returns singular-value-based objects and scores whose scaling differs from Stata displays.
detail_zh: 显式选择相关矩阵或协方差矩阵PCA。成分符号任意；prcomp返回基于奇异值的对象及得分，其缩放不同于Stata显示。
meaning: retain two principal components

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Compute the first two principal-component scores
task_zh: 计算前两个主成分得分
detail: Returns scores from the existing PCA fit. R score scaling and arbitrary component signs can differ from Stata predict, score; align normalization before comparing values.
detail_zh: 从已有PCA模型返回得分。R得分缩放及任意成分符号可能不同于Stata的predict, score；比较数值前须统一标准化。
meaning: compute the first two principal-component scores

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Estimate canonical correlations between two variable sets
task_zh: 估计两组变量间的典型相关
detail: Returns canonical correlations and coefficient matrices for the two variable blocks. Canonical signs and coefficient normalization are arbitrary; Stata also reports significance tests.
detail_zh: 返回两个变量组的典型相关及系数矩阵。典型变量符号和系数归一化任意；Stata还报告显著性检验。
meaning: estimate canonical correlations between two variable sets

stata: discrim lda x y z w, group(g)
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Fit LDA discriminant analysis
task_zh: 拟合线性判别分析
detail: Prior class probabilities and covariance estimation conventions should be specified before comparing results.
detail_zh: 比较结果前需明确类别先验概率与协方差估计约定。
meaning: fit lda discriminant analysis

stata: discrim qda x y z w, group(g)
r: { analysis <- droplevels(stats::model.frame(g ~ x + y + z + w, data = data, na.action = stats::na.omit)); groups <- length(unique(analysis$g)); MASS::qda(g ~ x + y + z + w, data = analysis, prior = rep(1 / groups, groups)) }
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Fit QDA discriminant analysis
task_zh: 拟合二次判别分析
detail: Explicit equal priors are computed from classes remaining after complete-case filtering of the response and predictors, matching Stata discrim qda default priors(equal). MASS otherwise uses sample class proportions. Align covariance normalization and class labels before comparing posterior probabilities.
detail_zh: 先对响应及预测变量筛选完整观测并去除未使用的类别，再按剩余类别计算等先验，匹配Stata的discrim qda默认priors(equal)。否则MASS采用样本类别比例。比较后验概率前须统一协方差归一化和类别标签。
meaning: fit qda discriminant analysis

stata: candisc x y z w, group(g)
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Estimate canonical linear discriminant directions
task_zh: 估计典型线性判别方向
detail: MASS lda supplies discriminant directions with equal class priors. This is a discriminant-analysis workflow, not the full Stata candisc canonical-test and normalization output.
detail_zh: MASS的lda以等类别先验提供判别方向。这是判别分析流程，不是Stata的candisc全部典型检验及归一化输出。
meaning: estimate canonical linear discriminant directions

stata: discrim lda x y z w, group(g) priors(equal)
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Use equal prior class probabilities in LDA
task_zh: 在线性判别分析中使用相等先验概率
detail: Equal class priors are explicit where shown. MASS coefficient normalization and class order can differ from Stata; compare posterior classifications after aligning priors and covariance estimates.
detail_zh: 所示代码显式使用等类别先验。MASS的系数归一化及类别顺序可能不同于Stata；须统一先验和协方差估计后比较后验分类。
meaning: use equal prior class probabilities in lda

stata: discrim knn x y z w, group(g) k(5)
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Classify observations using five nearest neighbors
task_zh: 使用五个最近邻进行分类
detail: Selects predictors by name and classifies the training observations. class::knn uses unweighted majority voting and random tie breaking; Stata defaults to equal class priors, which can change decisions for unbalanced classes. Use held-out data for predictive accuracy.
detail_zh: 按名称选择预测变量并对训练样本分类。class::knn采用不加权多数投票并随机处理并列；Stata默认采用等类别先验，类别不平衡时判别可能不同。预测准确率应在留出数据上评估。
meaning: classify observations using five nearest neighbors

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Predict discriminant-analysis class membership
task_zh: 预测判别分析类别归属
detail: Uses the existing discriminant fit and its class order. Returned labels or posterior-probability columns must match the fitted classes; R factor order need not match Stata category codes.
detail_zh: 使用已有判别模型及其类别顺序。返回标签或后验概率列须对应拟合类别；R因子顺序不必等于Stata类别编码顺序。
meaning: predict discriminant-analysis class membership

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Predict posterior probabilities for all discriminant classes
task_zh: 预测所有判别类别的后验概率
detail: Uses the existing discriminant fit and its class order. Returned labels or posterior-probability columns must match the fitted classes; R factor order need not match Stata category codes.
detail_zh: 使用已有判别模型及其类别顺序。返回标签或后验概率列须对应拟合类别；R因子顺序不必等于Stata类别编码顺序。
meaning: predict posterior probabilities for all discriminant classes

stata: discrim lda x y z w, group(g) lootable
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Classify using leave-one-out linear discriminant analysis
task_zh: 使用留一法线性判别分析分类
detail: Stata lootable requests leave-one-out classification; MASS CV=TRUE performs the corresponding prediction workflow.
detail_zh: Stata的lootable请求留一法分类；MASS的CV=TRUE完成对应预测流程。
meaning: classify using leave-one-out linear discriminant analysis

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Test multivariate group differences using Pillai
task_zh: 使用Pillai检验多变量组间差异
detail: Stata displays all four MANOVA statistics; this R example selects the named statistic.
detail_zh: Stata显示四种MANOVA统计量；此R示例选择其中指定的一种。
meaning: test multivariate group differences using pillai

task_zh: 使用Wilks检验多变量组间差异
detail: Stata displays all four MANOVA statistics; this R example selects the named statistic.

detail: Stata displays all four MANOVA statistics; this R example selects the named statistic.
detail_zh: Stata显示四种MANOVA统计量；此R示例选择其中指定的一种。
meaning: test multivariate group differences using roy

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Fit multivariate analysis of covariance
task_zh: 拟合多变量协方差分析
detail: Fits the stated multivariate linear model. R summary defaults to Pillai while Stata displays several multivariate criteria; choose the same criterion, hypothesis and factor contrasts.
detail_zh: 拟合所示多变量线性模型。R的summary默认Pillai，Stata显示多个多变量准则；须选择相同准则、假设和因子对比。
meaning: fit multivariate analysis of covariance

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Fit multivariate multiple regression
task_zh: 拟合多响应多元线性回归
detail: Returns a multivariate lm fit on the common complete-case sample. Stata mvreg displays separate equations and cross-equation summaries; request the corresponding R summaries explicitly.
detail_zh: 在共同完整样本上返回多变量lm拟合。Stata的mvreg显示各方程及跨方程汇总；R中须显式提取相应汇总。
meaning: fit multivariate multiple regression

r: { n <- nrow(data); k <- 2; m <- colMeans(data[c("x","y")]); T2 <- n*drop(t(m)%*%solve(stats::cov(data[c("x","y")]),m)); F <- (n-k)/(k*(n-1))*T2; c(T2=T2,F=F,p.value=stats::pf(F,k,n-k,lower.tail=FALSE)) }
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Test a vector of means against zero with Hotelling T squared
task_zh: 使用Hotelling T平方检验均值向量为零
detail: Computes the one-sample Hotelling T-squared and its F transformation for these two variables. Assumes a complete sample and invertible covariance; Stata additionally displays mean summaries.
detail_zh: 对这两个变量计算单样本Hotelling T平方及其F变换。假定样本完整且协方差可逆；Stata还显示均值汇总。
meaning: test a vector of means against zero with hotelling t squared

stata: mvtest normality x y z w, stats(skewness kurtosis)
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Compute Mardia multivariate skewness and kurtosis tests
task_zh: 计算Mardia多变量偏度与峰度检验
detail: Finite-sample corrections may differ; this selects Mardia components rather than Stata default Doornik-Hansen.
detail_zh: 小样本校正可能不同；此例选择Mardia分量，而非Stata默认Doornik-Hansen检验。
meaning: compute mardia multivariate skewness and kurtosis tests

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Perform simple correspondence analysis of a contingency table
task_zh: 对列联表进行简单对应分析
detail: MASS returns standard coordinates; Stata ca defaults to normalize(symmetric), so plotted coordinates differ in scale. Singular values and inertias are comparable, while axes may reverse signs. The table retains category names.
detail_zh: MASS返回标准坐标；Stata的ca默认normalize(symmetric)，故坐标尺度不同。奇异值和惯量可比，但坐标轴符号可能反向。列联表保留类别名称。
meaning: perform simple correspondence analysis of a contingency table

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Perform correspondence analysis of a supplied count matrix
task_zh: 对给定计数矩阵进行对应分析
detail: MASS returns standard correspondence coordinates; Stata defaults to symmetric normalization. Singular values are comparable, but coordinate scaling and axis signs can differ.
detail_zh: MASS返回标准对应坐标；Stata默认采用对称归一化。奇异值可比，但坐标缩放和轴符号可能不同。
meaning: perform correspondence analysis of a supplied count matrix

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Analyze multiple categorical variables through indicator MCA
task_zh: 通过指示矩阵MCA分析多个分类变量
detail: MASS uses an indicator-matrix MCA; inertia normalization differs from adjusted and joint MCA.
detail_zh: MASS采用指示矩阵MCA；惯量归一化不同于调整MCA和联合MCA。
meaning: analyze multiple categorical variables through indicator mca

stata: mds x y z w, id(id) dimension(2) noplot
section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Fit classical metric multidimensional scaling
task_zh: 拟合经典度量多维尺度分析
detail: Uses classical metric scaling of Euclidean distances. Stata mds defaults and stress criteria can differ; coordinates are comparable only after aligning distances, method, rotation and reflection.
detail_zh: 对欧氏距离采用经典度量缩放。Stata的mds默认方法及应力准则可能不同；须统一距离、方法、旋转和反射后比较坐标。
meaning: fit classical metric multidimensional scaling

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Scale an existing dissimilarity matrix
task_zh: 对给定相异性矩阵进行尺度分析
detail: Applies classical metric scaling to the supplied dissimilarity matrix. Match Stata metric method and eigenvalue treatment; coordinate rotations and reflections are arbitrary.
detail_zh: 对给定不相似矩阵采用经典度量缩放。须统一Stata的度量方法及特征值处理；坐标旋转和反射任意。
meaning: scale an existing dissimilarity matrix

task_zh: 拟合非度量多维尺度分析

detail_zh: 非度量优化、应力定义与初始配置可能不同。
meaning: fit nonmetric multidimensional scaling

task_zh: 对标准化变量进行单连接层次聚类

detail_zh: 对应的Stata调用前需先标准化变量；Ward距离及平方约定需特别核对。
meaning: fit singlelinkage hierarchical clustering on standardized variables

task: Partition standardized observations into three k-means clusters
task_zh: 把标准化观测划分为三个k均值聚类
detail: Algorithms, starts and random streams differ, so cluster numbering and local optima may differ.
detail_zh: 算法、起点与随机序列不同，聚类编号和局部最优解可能不同。

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Cut a hierarchical cluster tree into three groups
task_zh: 把层次聚类树切分为三组
detail: Cuts the existing hclust tree at three groups. The result is an integer membership vector; cluster labels are arbitrary and Stata generates a named dataset variable.
detail_zh: 将已有hclust树切为三组。结果为整数成员向量，聚类标签任意，而Stata生成具名数据变量。
meaning: cut a hierarchical cluster tree into three groups

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Cluster a precomputed dissimilarity matrix
task_zh: 对预先计算的相异性矩阵聚类
detail: Uses complete linkage on the supplied dissimilarity matrix. Dissimilarity definitions and tie breaking affect the tree; R returns an hclust object rather than a Stata named cluster solution.
detail_zh: 对给定不相似矩阵采用完全连接法。距离定义和并列处理影响树；R返回hclust对象，而非Stata具名聚类解。
meaning: cluster a precomputed dissimilarity matrix

task: Estimate a tetrachoric correlation by maximum likelihood
task_zh: 使用最大似然估计四分相关

detail_zh: 每个二元变量都必须观察到两个水平；推断假设潜在二元正态分布。
meaning: estimate a tetrachoric correlation by maximum likelihood

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Estimate unweighted Cohen kappa for two raters
task_zh: 估计两名评分者的非加权Cohen kappa
detail: Returns unweighted Cohen kappa from the cross-tabulation. It omits Stata agreement summaries, standard errors and confidence intervals; align missing-value and category handling.
detail_zh: 从列联表返回未加权Cohen kappa。不含Stata的一致率汇总、标准误和置信区间；须统一缺失及类别处理。

stata: sem (visual -> x1 x2 x3) (textual -> x4 x5 x6) (speed -> x7 x8 x9), latent(visual textual speed)

task_zh: 拟合三因子验证性测量模型

meaning: fit a three-factor confirmatory measurement model
expressions: visual =~ x1+x2+x3; textual =~ x4+x5+x6; speed =~ x7+x8+x9

section_zh: 多变量与心理测量方法
task: Report confirmatory-factor model fit indices
task_zh: 报告验证性因子模型拟合指标

detail_zh: 选择六个lavaan SEM拟合指标。须统一模型识别、似然缩放、缺失数据估计及基线模型定义；不包含Stata stats(all)的全部统计量。

task_zh: 检查结构方程模型修正指数

detail_zh: 返回lavaan对可释放参数的修正指数。须统一模型约束、信息矩阵和缺失数据似然；候选参数集合可能不同于Stata。
setup: data <- lavaan::HolzingerSwineford1939; fit <- lavaan::cfa("visual =~ x1+x2+x3; textual =~ x4+x5+x6; speed =~ x7+x8+x9",data=data)

task_zh: 报告标准化结构方程模型参数

detail_zh: 固定流程。

task: Plan the sample size for a onemean t test
task_zh: 设计单均值t检验所需样本量
detail: R reports n per group for an independent two-sample test; round sample sizes upward.
detail_zh: 独立双样本检验中R报告每组样本量；样本量应向上取整。
meaning: plan the sample size for a onemean t test

task: Calculate power for a fixed-size onemean t test
task_zh: 计算固定样本量单均值t检验功效
detail: Computes the displayed normal-theory t-test or two-proportion power design. R two-sample n is per group, whereas Stata n() is total; alternative, allocation and strict two-sided rejection conventions must match.
detail_zh: 计算所示正态理论t检验或两比例功效设计。R两样本n表示每组人数，Stata的n()表示总人数；须统一备择、分配及双侧拒绝规则。
meaning: calculate power for a fixed-size onemean t test

task: Find the detectable difference for a onemean t test
task_zh: 计算单均值t检验可检测差值
detail: R returns a positive detectable difference; add it to the null mean to recover the alternative mean.
detail_zh: R返回正的可检测差值；加上原假设均值即可得到备择均值。
meaning: find the detectable difference for a onemean t test

task: Plan the sample size for a pairedmeans t test
task_zh: 设计配对均值t检验所需样本量
detail: R reports n per group for an independent two-sample test; round sample sizes upward.

meaning: plan the sample size for a pairedmeans t test

detail: Uses ordinary ML with a log link for precision, matching Stata slink(log). Without link.phi="log", betareg reports constant phi on the identity scale while Stata reports ln(phi). Responses must lie strictly inside (0,1).
detail_zh: 采用常规ML及精度参数的log链接，匹配Stata的slink(log)。不指定link.phi="log"时，betareg在恒等尺度报告常数phi，Stata则报告ln(phi)。响应须严格位于(0,1)内。
setup: set.seed(2048); data <- data.frame(x=stats::rnorm(200),z=stats::rnorm(200)); mu <- stats::plogis(0.3+0.5*data$x); data$share <- stats::rbeta(200,mu*12,(1-mu)*12)
meaning: fit beta regression with a logit mean link

detail_zh: 使用显式左和或右删失界限。AER返回基于survreg的高斯删失模型；尺度参数报告和系数表推断不同于Stata。

task: Fit normal regression to interval-valued outcomes
task_zh: 对区间取值结果拟合正态回归
detail: Uses survreg as a Gaussian interval-likelihood engine for a cross-sectional outcome, without a time-to-event interpretation.
detail_zh: 将survreg用作截面结果的高斯区间似然计算工具，不赋予事件时间解释。
setup: set.seed(2048); data <- data.frame(x=stats::rnorm(200),z=stats::rnorm(200)); data$latent <- 1+0.6*data$x-0.3*data$z+stats::rnorm(200); data$lower <- floor(data$latent); data$upper <- data$lower+1
meaning: fit normal regression to interval-valued outcomes

task: Fit a normal mean model with multiplicative heteroskedasticity
task_zh: 拟合带乘性异方差的正态均值模型
detail: nlme models SD as exp(theta*z), so the coefficient on z in Stata log variance is 2*theta.
detail_zh: nlme将标准差建模为exp(theta*z)，因此Stata对数方差模型中z的系数为2*theta。
meaning: fit a normal mean model with multiplicative heteroskedasticity

task: Fit OLS with two coefficients constrained to equality
task_zh: 在两个系数相等的约束下拟合最小二乘回归
detail: Fixed workflow. First define constraint 1 x = z in Stata. Reparameterization imposes this fixed linear constraint; covariance reporting needs the corresponding coefficient transformation.
detail_zh: 固定流程。先在Stata中定义constraint 1 x = z；重参数化施加此固定线性约束，协方差报告需进行对应系数变换。
meaning: fit ols with two coefficients constrained to equality

task: Represent a linear equality constraint as a matrix
task_zh: 把线性等式约束表示为矩阵
detail: Fixed workflow: L beta = 0 encodes equal x and z coefficients. A fitting routine must enforce the constraint.
detail_zh: 固定流程：L beta = 0表示x与z系数相等；拟合程序需实际施加约束。
meaning: represent a linear equality constraint as a matrix

task: Correct a simple regression slope for known predictor reliability
task_zh: 按已知解释变量信度校正简单回归斜率
detail: Coefficient-only workflow for one error-prone predictor with known reliability and classical independent measurement error; no EIV standard errors are supplied.
detail_zh: 仅适用于单个存在经典独立测量误差且信度已知的解释变量；仅计算系数，不提供EIV标准误。
meaning: correct a simple regression slope for known predictor reliability

task: Maximize an explicitly defined normal likelihood
task_zh: 最大化显式定义的正态似然
detail: R optimizes log sigma to enforce positivity; translate the scale parameter back using exp().
detail_zh: R对log sigma优化以确保正值；使用exp()变换回标准差。
meaning: maximize an explicitly defined normal likelihood

task: Calculate the overall Brier mean probability score
task_zh: 计算总体Brier均方概率评分

detail_zh: 此例仅返回总体评分；Stata的brier还报告分解分量。
meaning: calculate the overall brier mean probability score

task: Estimate a nonparametric ROC area for a marker
task_zh: 估计诊断标记的非参数ROC曲线下面积
detail: Explicit direction means larger markers indicate cases; fixing direction prevents data-driven reversal.
detail_zh: 显式指定较大标记值表示病例；固定方向可避免按数据自动反向。
setup: set.seed(2048); data <- data.frame(b=rep(c(0L,1L),each=60)); data$x <- stats::rnorm(120,mean=data$b); data$z <- stats::rnorm(120,mean=0.5*data$b)
meaning: estimate a nonparametric roc area for a marker

task: Tabulate sensitivity and specificity across ROC thresholds
task_zh: 列出不同ROC阈值的敏感度与特异度
detail: Returns all pROC thresholds with sensitivity and specificity for explicit event direction. Threshold locations and endpoint conventions differ from Stata roctab detail cutpoints.
detail_zh: 在显式事件方向下返回pROC全部阈值、敏感度和特异度。阈值位置及端点约定不同于Stata的roctab detail切点。
setup: set.seed(2048); data <- data.frame(b=rep(c(0L,1L),each=60)); data$x <- stats::rnorm(120,mean=data$b); data$z <- stats::rnorm(120,mean=0.5*data$b)
meaning: tabulate sensitivity and specificity across roc thresholds

task: Compare paired marker ROC areas using DeLong inference
task_zh: 使用DeLong推断比较配对标记的ROC面积
detail: Both markers must be measured on the same complete-case subjects for paired inference.
detail_zh: 配对推断要求两个标记在相同完整样本受试者上测量。
setup: set.seed(2048); data <- data.frame(b=rep(c(0L,1L),each=60)); data$x <- stats::rnorm(120,mean=data$b); data$z <- stats::rnorm(120,mean=0.5*data$b)
meaning: compare paired marker roc areas using delong inference

task: Solve a noncentral chi-squared probability for noncentrality
task_zh: 由非中心卡方概率反求非中心参数
detail: Numerically inverts the noncentral chi-square CDF over the displayed noncentrality bracket. Other inputs may need a wider bracket; Stata performs its own domain validation and inversion.
detail_zh: 在所示非中心参数区间内数值反解非中心卡方CDF。其他输入可能需要更宽区间；Stata使用自身的定义域验证和反解。
meaning: solve a noncentral chi-squared probability for noncentrality

task: Solve a noncentral F probability for noncentrality
task_zh: 由非中心F概率反求非中心参数
detail: Numerically inverts the noncentral F CDF over the displayed bracket. Other inputs can require a different bracket; solver tolerances differ from Stata.
detail_zh: 在所示区间内数值反解非中心F的CDF。其他输入可能需要不同区间；求解容差不同于Stata。
meaning: solve a noncentral f probability for noncentrality

task: Solve a noncentral t probability for noncentrality
task_zh: 由非中心t概率反求非中心参数
detail: Numerically inverts the noncentral t CDF over the displayed bracket. Negative or larger noncentralities require different bounds; solver tolerances differ from Stata.
detail_zh: 在所示区间内数值反解非中心t的CDF。负值或更大的非中心参数需要不同边界；求解容差不同于Stata。
meaning: solve a noncentral t probability for noncentrality

task: Evaluate a correlated bivariate normal probability
task_zh: 计算相关二元正态概率
detail: Evaluates a bivariate normal probability using mvtnorm numerical integration. Integration tolerance and numerical rounding differ from the Stata distribution function.
detail_zh: 用mvtnorm数值积分计算二元正态概率。积分容差及数值舍入不同于Stata分布函数。
meaning: evaluate a correlated bivariate normal probability

task: Evaluate a multivariate normal log density
task_zh: 计算多变量正态对数密度
detail: Fixed example uses mean M=(0,0), covariance V=I(2), and evaluation vector X=(1,2).
detail_zh: 固定示例：均值M=(0,0)，协方差V=I(2)，求值向量X=(1,2)。
meaning: evaluate a multivariate normal log density

task: Evaluate an inverse-gamma log density
task_zh: 计算逆伽马分布对数密度
detail: Uses the reciprocal-gamma change of variables with its log-Jacobian. Match Stata shape and scale parameterization; numerical tail underflow can differ.
detail_zh: 使用倒数gamma变量变换及其对数Jacobian。须统一Stata的形状和尺度参数化；数值尾部下溢行为可能不同。
meaning: evaluate an inverse-gamma log density

task: Draw independent standard normal columns jointly
task_zh: 联合生成独立标准正态变量列
detail: Random streams differ; R returns a data frame of generated columns.
detail_zh: 随机序列不同；R返回包含所生成变量列的数据框。
meaning: draw independent standard normal columns jointly

task: Generate pseudo-data with exactly specified sample moments
task_zh: 生成样本矩精确符合指定值的伪数据
detail: empirical=TRUE imposes the sample mean and covariance; such pseudo-data are not independent random draws.
detail_zh: empirical=TRUE强制样本均值和协方差符合设定；此类伪数据不是独立随机抽样。
meaning: generate pseudo-data with exactly specified sample moments
